caseId.title: Case Id
caseId.description: Salesforce record Id of the created case

caseNumber.title: Case Number
caseNumber.description: Case Number of the created case

caseResult.title: Case Result
caseResult.description: Case number and case Id of the created case, shown to the customer

contactId.title: Contact Id
contactId.description: Id of the Contact the case is linked to

errorMessage.title: Error Message
errorMessage.description: Customer-safe reason the case could not be created, for example a missing full name

errorType.title: Error Type
errorType.description: Error category if the case could not be created

isSuccess.title: Is Success
isSuccess.description: True only if the case was actually created. If false, no case exists.
